name: Saros 10R
measure_description: Dock and robot measured together at the wall. Charging uses battery_rate at 1.00 Wh per battery %, so it follows both slow and fast charging; over eight, charging energy came within 1% of the plug's energy counter. Mop drying adds 56.2 W to the 3.5 W docked baseline. Robot: S91COP, 20 V 2.5 A. Dock: EWFD28LRR, 120 V 60 Hz.
config_flow_sub_profile_remarks: Pick the sub-profile that matches the mop wash water temperature set in the Roborock app. Home Assistant can't read this setting, so change the sub-profile here if you change it in the app.
